channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Friday's public rental tape is another full six-venue confirm session. Live re-read of Lambda / CoreWeave NA+EU / Crusoe / DigitalOcean / GCP TPU / AWS Capacity Blocks: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Lambda on-demand anchors hold at H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97 all confirm versus Thursday. CoreWeave /pricing remains HTTP 200 with NA OD Inference prints (H100 $6.16 / B200 $8.60) confirming. AWS Capacity Blocks still banners the rate card effective 7 Oct 2026 while the live table prints current rates (P5 Virginia $5.191 CONFIRM). Applied Digital's Brookwood / Delta Forge 2 campus is the day after its stated ~1 Oct window: Thursday night town hall; Mayor Joe Barger calls the project essentially a done deal, with City Council still needing to vote a TCEDA-backing resolution (expected in the coming days); no primary groundbreak filing found and the hyperscaler tenant remains unnamed. One Wire id: Bitdeer AI's 29 Sep Malaysia A201 offtake (>70% of 21.7 MW). PUCT 58481 still Interchange 218/219 (effective 10.08.2026); TCEQ Abbott update still due 19 Oct; ERCOT RFI still due 12 Oct CPT; Fermi x TensorWave Matador still due 31 Oct; Chicago O2026-0028856 still introduction-only.
